terms.quote: Issuer: | Citigroup Global Markets Holdings Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Citigroup Inc.
Filed Pursuant to Rule 424(b)(2)
Underlying: | The S&P 500® Index
Initial underlying value: | 7,801.77, the closing value of the underlying on the pricing date
Underlying: | The S&P 500® Index
Stated principal amount: | $1,000 per security
Pricing date: | October 7, 2026
Issue date: | October 13, 2026
Maturity date: | December 10, 2027
Valuation date: | December 7, 2027, subject to postponement if such date is not a scheduled trading day or certain market disruption events occur

If the final underlying value is greater than the initial underlying value, you will lose 1% of the stated principal amount of your securities for every 1% by which the final underlying value is greater than the initial underlying value, subject to the maximum loss at maturity.
If the final underlying value is greater than or equal to the initial underlying value:
Final underlying value: | The closing value of the underlying on the valuation date
Guarantee: | All payments due on the securities are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Citigroup Inc.
CUSIP / ISIN: | 17334DTT9 / US17334DTT99
Participation rate: | 250.00%
Maximum return at maturity: | $1,000.00 per security (100.00% of the stated principal amount).
On the date of this pricing supplement, the estimated value of the securities is $969.70 per security, which is less than the issue price.
CGMI will pay selected dealers not affiliated with CGMI a variable selling concession of up to $23.50 for each security they sell to accounts other than fee-based advisory accounts.
The securities offer modified inverse exposure to the performance of the underlying, which means that you will receive a positive return at maturity only if the underlying depreciates
